overview.lead: Druids can tank, heal or deal damage. Blizzard describes their healing as heals over time that reward planning, and names their gaps: no snares, no silence or interrupt, and lighter crowd control, so Druids lean on their group in dungeons and raids.

points.text: For Olympus (Alliance), Druids are Night Elf or High Order Skyborne. Skyborne needs a paid Forever upgrade and has its own bird-like form models. On 26 Oct its Read Ley Line racial dropped to a 50% regen bonus that can't be used during Innervate.
Main changes from Classic: most potions, weapon enchants and procs now work in form, Moonkin Aura and Leader of the Pack reach the whole raid, and Restoration gains Wild Growth at 31 points.

101.summary: What every Druid should know before choosing a spec.

overview.lead: Balance is the Druid caster spec: Nature and Arcane damage from range, ending in Moonkin Form at 31 points, which gives your raid spell crit.

points.text: In Forever, Insect Swarm is a 16-point Balance talent (damage over time that also lowers the target's hit chance), and the new Eclipse talent lets Wrath speed up your next Starfires.
Warcraft Tavern's Forever guide argues Balance has left its Classic reputation behind, while admitting its endgame performance is still unknown.

101.summary: Leveling, the core rotation and the habits that matter first.

steps.text: Talents start at level 10. Balance reaches Nature's Splendor at 11 points, Insect Swarm at 16, and row-5 picks such as Nature's Grace and Eclipse at 21.
Improved Wrath makes your main filler faster and cheaper. Improved Entangling Roots lets Roots hold through more damage, and Roots now works indoors.
Nature's Grasp is baseline at level 10 and works in forms and indoors, which gives you an escape.
Dual Specialization unlocks at level 40, so you can keep Balance and a second spec.
Apply Moonfire and Insect Swarm to targets that live long enough for the damage to tick.
Cast Wrath to bank Eclipse charges: each Wrath readies your next 2 Starfires to cast faster, up to 4 charges for 15 s. Then spend them on Starfire.
Stay in Moonkin Form: you can cast every non-healing spell in it, and it doubles your Omen of Clarity chance.
Hurricane (level 40) has no cooldown in Forever, so use it on large packs.
Nature's Grace speeds up your casts and global cooldown for 3 s after a non-periodic crit, so a Starfire crit makes the next cast faster.
Omen of Clarity is now a baseline spell at level 20, so keep it active; Moonkin Form doubles its chance to trigger.
Thorns now scales with spell power.
Moonkin Form raises armor from items a lot (360% per the talent text), which helps when something reaches you.
Keep Rebirth (level 20) and Innervate (level 40) on your bars; they were the Druid's signature raid tools in Classic too.

201.summary: Stat priorities, raid duties, consumables and PvP.

steps.text: As a caster you want distance: Warcraft Tavern points to Druid mobility (Dash, Travel Form, Teleport: Moonglade) and baseline Nature's Grasp as your escape tools.
Balance adds Insect Swarm to lower an attacker's hit chance, Entangling Roots that works indoors (Overgrowth lets it hold one more target) and Improved Starfire's small chance to stun.
Forms have been immune to Disarm since 1 Oct, and Moonkin Form multiplies armor from items.
Against Warlock: Warcraft Tavern notes Warlocks have no blink or sprint, so Entangling Roots and range let you set the distance.
Against Rogue: Insect Swarm lowers their chance to hit, and baseline Nature's Grasp gives you a way out when they open on you.

overview.lead: Feral tanks in Bear Form and deals melee damage in Cat Form. Leader of the Pack benefits every type of critical strike and is exclusive with Moonkin Aura.

points.text: Choose the Bear or Cat path for the job you do most. Primal Bite follows Leader of the Pack, and Shifting Power follows Predatory Discipline. Both are 31-point choices.
Weapon enchants, procs and most potions now work in form, and form auto-attacks use your weapon's DPS, so your weapon matters.

101.summary: Leveling, the core rotation and the habits that matter first.

steps.text: Bear Form comes from a level-10 quest and Cat Form from a new level-20 quest chain; Travel Form (30) and Dire Bear Form (40) are trained.
Feral Swiftness makes Cat Form faster and adds dodge, and Thick Hide adds armor in Bear, Cat and Moonkin Form.
Lacerate is on row 4. Leader of the Pack leads to Primal Bite, and Cats learn Poised at level 32.
Upgrade your weapon as you level, since form attacks use its DPS. Warcraft Tavern says Druids can use polearms from level 20; Blizzard has not confirmed it.
Cat: open from Prowl, build combo points with Claw, Rake and Shred, then spend them on Rip.
Cat: after Predatory Discipline, take Shifting Power at 31 points. Use it when Energy is low, not while Energy is full.
Bear: Growl to taunt, Swipe for packs and Maul for single targets. Add Lacerate on row 4 and Primal Bite on row 7 once talented.
Bear: Faerie Fire (Feral) is free in form on a 6 s cooldown and now causes threat, so use it often.
In Bear Form, use Swipe when you need threat on several targets. In Cat Form, start from full Energy to benefit from Poised once you reach level 32.
Rage potions and Thistletea now work in form, and Mana Potions in form came back on 8 Oct.
Bears still cannot block or parry (Warcraft Tavern), so dodge, armor and health carry your defense.
Frenzied Regeneration can heal up to 100% of your max health over its duration; use it when a pull runs long.
Doors, objects and racials can now be used without leaving form.

201.summary: Stat priorities, raid duties, consumables and PvP.

steps.text: Warcraft Tavern highlights Druid mobility (Prowl, Dash, Travel Form, Teleport: Moonglade), Nature's Grasp as a baseline escape, and Bear Form for peeling and survival.
Feral Charge (11 points) immobilizes and interrupts; its Cat version leaps behind the target on a 30 s cooldown without rooting or interrupting. Brutal Impact lengthens Bash and Pounce stuns.
Berserk is gone. Plan your opener and escape around the control your opponent can still use.
Against Warlock: Against a Fear user, stay in range of friendly dispels or save a line-of-sight route. The older Berserk immunity is gone.
Against Mage: Blizzard calls Mages fragile in melee; Feral Charge and Cat Form help you close the gap and stay on them.

overview.lead: Restoration heals mostly with heals over time: Rejuvenation, Regrowth and, at 31 points, Wild Growth, a new party heal over time that also covers pets.

points.text: Since 24 Sep, Rejuvenation, Tranquility and Wild Growth can crit, and Swiftmend (16 points) no longer consumes the heal over time it draws on.
Blizzard calls Druid healing less versatile than a Priest's and built on planning, so put heals over time out before the damage lands.

101.summary: Leveling, the core rotation and the habits that matter first.

steps.text: Bloom heals when your Rejuvenation or Regrowth expires. It also heals for a smaller amount when either effect is dispelled.
Cure Poison comes from a level-14 quest, and Remove Curse (24) and Abolish Poison (26) arrive while you level.
Revive (12) brings allies back out of combat, and Rebirth (20) works in combat.
Dual Specialization at level 40 lets you keep Feral or Balance for questing.
Keep Rejuvenation on targets taking steady damage, and add Regrowth when someone needs a direct heal plus a heal over time.
Swiftmend instantly heals a target that has your Rejuvenation or Regrowth, and the heal over time keeps running.
Use Wild Growth when a whole party takes damage; it heals fast at first and slows down over 7 s.
Nature's Swiftness makes your next Nature spell instant; save it for emergencies.
Tranquility (level 30) is your big group heal; Improved Tranquility cuts its cooldown and threat.
Nature's Focus gives a chance to avoid interruption when you are hit while casting (14% at rank 1).
Living Spirit (required for Wild Growth) raises Spirit, and Reflection keeps part of your regen going while you cast.
Mark of the Wild (level 1) and Gift of the Wild (level 50) are your raid buffs, and Improved Mark of the Wild is now baseline.
Innervate arrives at level 40.

201.summary: Stat priorities, raid duties, consumables and PvP.

steps.text: Your heals over time keep ticking after the cast, and Swiftmend and Nature's Swiftness give you instant emergency heals.
You keep the Druid escape kit: Nature's Grasp, Travel Form and Dash, plus Bear Form when you need to survive a burst.
